title: Parsing a Query String
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and $y$ a Boolean list. If $y$ has at least $n$ entries, take its first $n$ bits as a function on the indices $0,[4m\ldots[0m,n-1$, and parse the remainder as two consecutive delimited fields using the Boolean-field reader. When both fields parse successfully, return the first $n$ bits and the two parsed fields together with the unconsumed suffix; otherwise return no result.
